description: Text and situation probes: the tasks small models are known to fail because the answer needs deterministic counting, transforming, or ordering over characters and words rather than language modelling (the "how many r in raspberry" class). Every derivable expectation is computed from the source material declared in `derivation`, and tests/text-probes.test.mjs re-derives them. Evaluation-only material: it never enters training.
source: Authored for this repository after the reported small-model failure modes for letter counting, word sorting, and single-step situation traps (see e.g. arxiv 2412.18626 on letter counting).

measuredIn: Direct-answer mode: the suite asks the model for the value with its own system prompt, so it measures what a small model can do WITHOUT compiling a plan. The project thesis is that these tasks become solvable by compiling them into a circuit that delegates the counting to jsEval, which is why the text example families exist in the training data; the compiled-plan comparison uses the same tasks through the compiled-plan profile plus execution.
